name: 雾粉奶油光
author: Shinji
tagline: 赵露思写真 · 雾粉奶油光 · 樱粉饰线
taglineEn: Zhao Lusi portraits, creamy rose light and sakura hairlines
description: 以赵露思写真为素材的浅色暖调皮肤：雾粉奶油光背景、樱粉强调色、侧栏人物竖条、着陆页竖幅主视觉与同脸系图标。
descriptionEn: A warm, low-contrast portrait skin built from Zhao Lusi photography: creamy rose light, sakura accent lines, a sidebar portrait and a matching icon family.
